test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Radha said, “Why didn’t he forward his petition to me?”

options.text: Radha enquired why he had not forwarded his petition to her.
Radha enquired why he has not forwarded his petition to her.
Radha enquired why had he not forwarded his petition to her.
Radha enquired why he had not forward his petition to her.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Radha enquired why he had not forwarded his petition to her.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to indirect speech.
 
• When we change a direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" is changed to "enquired" in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are removed to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is removed in the indirect speech.
 
• The **question mark (?)** is omitted in the indirect speech.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech should be in capital letters.
 
• The **simple past tense** (did not forward) in the direct speech changes to the **past perfect tense** (had not forwarded) in the indirect speech.
 
• The first person pronoun "**me**" changed to the third person pronoun "**her**" in the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer which follows the rules properly.

 

Hence, indirect speech is - *Radha enquired why he had not forwarded his petition to her.*
